description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [PHY +30% Boost (15s)], [Break Arts Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Break Arts Mode
description.text: Casts Heavy Strike/Heavy Strike+/Heavy Strike++ and Orbital Edge after using three Earth abilities if the character dealt 0/72001/240001 damage during the status, removed after triggering

description.name: Heavy Strike
description.text: Three single attacks (0.52 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Heavy Strike+
description.text: Five single attacks (0.52 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Heavy Strike++
description.text: Five single attacks (0.52 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Orbital Edge
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.50 each) and one single attack (5.00) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate
